definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (entry 4.145) 'A file that is opened in either the output mode or extend mode' and §2023:3.141 'can only be written or extended' name the same files. In GR3 'the associated output file' is the sort-merge file of record-name-1 in both editions (an SD file is never OPENed), so the definition does not change which files the SAME RECORD AREA availability covers; scope and evidence unchanged.
